summary: Request to add cryptographically signed attestations to Temporal releases for verifying authenticity and provenance, moving beyond current checksum-only approach.
userImpact: Users cannot cryptographically verify authenticity and provenance of Temporal releases, only basic integrity via checksums.
proposedFix: Add attestations to release workflow using actions/attest and goreleaser patterns, uploading attestation bundle files as release artifacts for verification without GitHub authentication.
keyQuote: This is perhaps even more important for `temporal` which operates at a critical core level of workflows.
